text: __NOTOC__ Highlands Mill is a lumber mill located in western Arathi Highlands, and it is the primary source of lumber for Stromgarde Keep. The Hinterlands, located in the eastern part of Lordaeron, is probably most notable for the Wildhammer dwarves who make their residence at Aerie Peak in the west. The Wildhammers have always been staunch allies of the Alliance. It is from the Hinterlands that these dwarves find and tame their world-renowned gryphons. The Razorbeak gryphons roam wild in this region. Also in the Hinterlands is one of the last remaining settlements of the high elves in Lordaeron at the Quel'Danil Lodge. The Hinterlands are also home to a large population of forest trolls, which are divided into three separate tribes. The Revantusk tribe is the only one that has declared sides in the Horde-Alliance conflict and

A hippogryph, also called a windgryph, is a beast with the hindquarters of a mighty black stag and the head, wings, and forelegs of a large raven. Antlers rise from its feathered head. They are frequently used as mounts by the night elves, the draenei and the Gilneans. Hippogryphs are highly intelligent, sentient beings; far more than mere "mounts".

Hive'Ashi Workers are silithid scarabs that live in Hive'Ashi in Silithus. These bugs are neutral and will not attack unless attacked themselves or if they patrol by a mob you are engaging. They are fairly uncommon, and have long patrol routes inside and outside found around the perimeter of the hive.

Hive'Regal Burrowers are silithid scarabs that live in Hive'Regal in Silithus. These bugs are neutral and will not attack unless attacked themselves or if they patrol by a mob you are engaging. They do not spawn in as many areas as the other types of bugs, but have a much shorter spawn timer, and have long patrol routes inside and outside found around the perimeter of the hive.

A hoax is a false rumor known by the author to be false and debunked or disproven. Blizzard usually puts forth various hoaxes before or during April Fool's day. Examples of World of Warcraft hoaxes: * Pandaren Xpress * Two-headed ogre * BurgerCraft * Wisp (April Fool's) * Gold dupe hoax

Hogun is one of the members of the Explorers' Guild. He was was one of the most accomplished explorers in the Barrens region. He was seeking to uncover the secrets of the past in the area. He was tasked with finding the location of ancient site of Bael Modan and the titan ruins buried within. His archaeological mission was to survey and map the area around Bael Modan. He was convinced he could find a cave or tunnel leading to an underground chamber of titan design in the area. To help him with his mission, he had set up a small wilderness camp near Bael Modan, and built a small campfire. At this camp he had been surprised by a lone worg, who attacked and killed him. The pandaren race has been part of the Warcraft franchise long before appearing as a playable race in World of Warcraft. This article documents the history of the concept, from their beginnings as a recurring in-joke and easter egg before the release of Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos (2002) until their official introduction in World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria (2012).

The Hinterlands are a level 30-35 contested zone. Both Alliance and Horde players arrive here from a tunnel in the Arathi Highlands, but after that, their directions diverge. At first, the factions deal with the rivalry between the Wildhammer clan and Revantusk tribe; eventually, they discover a cult of spider-worshiping Vilebranch trolls in Jintha'Alor and summon and defeat their deity, Shadra the Venom Queen. The progress for the storyline is tracked in the achievement Hinterlands Quests.

Hillpaw's Chickens are chickens located in the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds. They can be revealed to be: *Wild Prairie Chicken *Amorous Rooster *Lost Hen *Disguised Marmot *Old Hillpaw's Prize Chicken

Hisek the Swarmkeeper is a mantid located at Klaxxi'vess. Hisek is a paranoid mantid who can track scents and is an expert at rooting out corruption and spies. His fighting style consists of using a gun similar in look to the Larvae of the Great Worm and firing from a distance.
Hoff Greasegun was a level 92 Kor'kron Commander goblin located at Northern Barrens. When attacked, he summoned Mugg.
Hogzilla is a rare boar that can be found near Blackchar Cave in the Searing Gorge.
Hired Engineers are gnomes located at the Expedition Base Camp in Ulduar.
__NOTOC__ Hisek's Reserve Longbow drops from Paragons of the Klaxxi in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
History of the Mantid is a professions achievement earned for restoring and displaying pristine versions of all Mantid artifacts.
Hogs' Studded Collar is an achievement reward from That's Whack!. It summons Hogs, a battle pet version of the infamous Hogger.
Hive Queen Skrikka is found at in an overgrown tower at the east end of Overlook Ruins in Gorgrond. Defeat her to acquire Skrikka's Mandible and 10-20 Garrison Resources.
Hippopat is one of two riverbeast pets belonging to the Alliance Hunter Leader Kamatari Whisperwind, to be found escorting her as she patrols Stormshield Outpost.
Hoggle is a pug located at the Secret Aerie in the Veiled Stair.
The Hills of Valuun are a large, hilly plain northwest of Karabor in . Herds of Rockhide elekk, Seacliff kaliri and Shaded plainstalkers reside in great numbers in this area.
Hobaat is a draenei vendor located at the Beacon of Sha'tar in Talador.
__NOTOC__ Hol'bruk the Brewcrusher is an ogre located at Highmaul in . He will only turn hostile once you try to steal his booze.
History of Violence is an achievement earned by using the Jewel of Transformation to find artifacts under the boulder piles in the Broken Precipice in .
__NOTOC__ Hoarfrost is a rare ice fury located at the Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge. The elemental is surrounded by numerous Mind-Frozen Rockbiters.
The Hinterlands Gatewardens are dryads found at the gate to the Hinterlands in the Emerald Dreamway.

Hillsbrad Sentries are humans who were defending the Azurelode Mine in the Hillsbrad Foothills. They have now been captured by the Forsaken. It is interesting to note that they share their uniform with the Lordaeron Watchmen of the Old Hillsbrad Foothills.
The Hired Bard is a dwarf who can be found in the Chamber of Shadows in the Hall of Shadows.

Hitting the Books is the hunter version quest designed to introduce artifact research to the player. Each of the Artifact Research Notes created cost 500 Order Resources and take three days to complete.
Hoard of Gallywix is a carrier located at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.

Hiro is jungle troll monk first appearing in the Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit. He and Angus Ironfist are good friends. He joined the Order of the Broken Temple and was sent on a mission to the Gates of Valor in Stormheim where he was captured and put in a cage by the demons. After being rescued from the Legion by the Grandmaster, he returned to the Temple of Five Dawns and pledged himself to them as their champion.
Hillsbrad Foremen are humans located in Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Hira Ambrosino is a voice actress that voiced the pandaren females in .
Hogtied Razormanes si a Razormane Pillager when captured for Drag it Out of Them.
The Historical Parchment is a scroll found in Archivist Ionaa's cave in Krokul Hovel in Krokuun.
Holaja Da Drunk is a Zandalari troll located at the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.

HiveWE is an open source, fan-made world editor for Warcraft III created by the Hive Workshop team. It is meant to provide a fully functional replacement and improvement to the official world editor for Warcraft III. [https://github.com/stijnherfst/HiveWE HiveWE] is currently limited and in beta.
Hissing Swells are unbound water elementals located at Fizzsprings Resort in Tiragarde Sound.
The Hogger "Costume" is a discarded gnoll "costume" located in the Stormwind Stockade. It was used by Kazul who was imprisoned for impersonating Hogger.
Hoarder Jena is the emissary and quartermaster for the Voldunai, located at the Vulpera Hideaway in Vol'dun.
Hired Mechanics are goblins and gnomes located at Veil Zekk in the Spires of Arak. They are working on a Drill Cannon.
Hir'eek's Lair is a pit in Zalamar, Nazmir where the loa Hir'eek resides and is worshipped. The entrance is The Fall, and descends deeper to the Sanctum of Midnight.
__NOTOC__ Hivemother Kraxi is a wasp vignette located in a large cave accessed from the Prickly Grove in Vol'dun.
Hive Mother's Stinger drops from Hive Mother in Stormsong Valley.

__NOTOC__ Hobbs is a human situated inside The Golden Flagon inn within Brennadam in Stormsong Valley. He trades various items for Briarback Quills.
